description: Source code implementing password handling and server connection functions for the SRP authentication project, including password file access, server opening, and password retrieval.

methods.name: t_serveropen
methods.description: Opens a server connection for a given username by retrieving user password info and initializing server.

methods.name: t_openpw
methods.description: Opens a password file stream, deprecated when called with NULL.

methods.name: t_openpwbyname
methods.description: Opens a password file by filename.

methods.name: t_closepw
methods.description: Closes a password file stream and frees associated memory.

methods.name: t_rewindpw
methods.description: Rewinds the password file stream to the beginning.

methods.name: gettpnam
methods.description: Retrieves password information for a given username, initializing system password data if necessary.
